name: SVC_ARCH_EXPORT_HIST
description: This table is used to store history of bulk export jobs submitted by archive job.

columns.name: BULK_EXPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: Job Id generated from a bulk export Job.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Name of object that is exported, e.g., ServiceRequest, HRHelpDeskRequest, InternalServiceRequest.

columns.name: OBJECT_IDS
columns.description: Comma-separated Object IDs, e.g., SR IDs that are being passed to the export job.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ARCH_STATUS
columns.description:
Current status of Export Job.

 Here are the details of possible values:

QUEUED - This is the status of the Export Job API.

PREPARING_TO_EXPORT - This is the status of the Export Job API.

EXPORTING_DATA - This is the status of the Export Job API.

COMPLETING_EXPORT_ACTIVITY -  This is the status of the Export Job API.

COMPLETE - This is the status of the Export Job API.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Document ID pointing to the file created by Export job.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINK
columns.description: Link to download the Archived file.
